description: This file defines the VacancyDecorator class within the OrangeHRM project, providing utility methods to manipulate Vacancy entities such as setting related JobTitle and Employee entities by ID, and evaluating vacancy status.

classes.name: VacancyDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the Vacancy entity providing methods to associate job titles and employees, and check vacancy status.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a specific Vacancy object.

methods.name: setJobTitleById
methods.description: Sets the JobTitle of the Vacancy using a given JobTitle ID.

methods.name: getVacancy
methods.description: Returns the Vacancy object associated with this decorator.

methods.name: setEmployeeById
methods.description: Sets the hiring manager of the Vacancy using a given Employee ID.

methods.name: isActiveAndPublished
methods.description: Checks if the Vacancy is both published and active.
